board.name: VELA_IF310_DVK
board.summary: Built on Infineon’s AIROC™ CYW55310, the Vela IF310 brings together Bluetooth® Classic (BR/EDR) and is Bluetooth® Core 6.0 certified—including LE Audio with LC3, Isochronous Channels, Auracast, LE Coded & 2M PHY and Advertising Extensions—so you can refresh legacy Classic designs and embrace the latest LE Audio opportunities with one module. A 192 MHz ARM® Cortex-M33, integrated audio interfaces, up to +10 dBm output power, HCI UART interface for a variety of hosted applications or ModusToolbox™ support for embedded hostless use cases. The Vela IF310 delivers a low-risk, fast-to-market platform for demanding medical or industrial audio and data applications.
board.prov_capabilities: arduino bsp_gen4 bt cat5 cyw55513 cyw55xxx flash_0k hal i2c i2s led low_power mcu_gp memory pdm qspi rtc sdio pot spi sram_768k switch tdm uart
board.description:
Vela IF310 DVK Features:
  • Vela IF310 Bluetooth®/Bluetooth® Low Energy 6.0 module
  • Supports BDR, EDR, LE audio (LC3 codec), LE long range, LE 2 Mbps, LE mesh, and advertising extensions
  • Dual TDM/I2S audio interfaces supporting HFP, A2DP, and LE audio use cases
  • PDM interface for digital microphone connectivity
  • USB Type-C connector for power, programming, and USB-UART bridge

Kit Contents:
  • VELA IF310 DVK evaluation board
  • 5pcs jumper caps
  • 4pcs stand-offs and nuts
  • USB Type-C cable
  • Six jumper wires (5 inches each)
